module_summary: Traffic light controller with 4-state FSM (BOOT, STOP, SLOW, GO) managing lamp sequencing via timer, verification pipeline delays output by one cycle, supports early green transitions.

anchors.name: lamp
anchors.why: FSM state register controlling traffic light sequence (BOOT/STOP/GO/SLOW)

anchors.name: tmr
anchors.why: 8-bit timer countdown register; drives state transitions via hit3 comparison

anchors.name: hit3
anchors.why: Timer comparison (tmr == 3); gates FSM state transitions in combinational logic

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Red lamp output controlled by history register (one-cycle delayed from lamp state)

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Yellow lamp output controlled by history register (one-cycle delayed from lamp state)

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Green lamp output controlled by history register (one-cycle delayed from lamp state)

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: External request to enable early green transition when conditions are met

anchors.name: cut_short
anchors.why: Triggers timer reset (10) when pass_request, green, and tmr > 10; enables early transition

anchors.name: hr
anchors.why: History register for red lamp; implements one-cycle verification delay from lamp state

anchors.name: fresh_g
anchors.why: Detects green output transition; gates timer update to 60 when green becomes active

anchors.name: clock
anchors.why: Timer value output to external clock/timing reference

groups.name: FSM_Controller
groups.description: 4-state FSM with combinational next-state logic controlled by hit3

groups.name: Timer_Logic
groups.description: 8-bit countdown timer with hit3 comparison triggering state transitions

groups.name: Verification_Pipeline
groups.description: One-cycle delay pipeline: hr/hy/hg hold lamp state for verified output to red/yellow/green

groups.name: Output_Interface
groups.description: Traffic light output signals with delayed state-based control

groups.name: Output_Change_Detection
groups.description: Detects transitions on red/yellow/green outputs; gates timer multiplexer

groups.name: Priority_Control
groups.description: Pass request input and cut_short control for early green transitions

groups.name: Timer_Output
groups.description: Timer value as external reference output
